item.title: Ukraine fires two senior security officials amid corruption probe into scam call centers
item.description: Ukraine's security service has fired two senior officials amid a corruption investigation into an alleged criminal network that bribed law enforcement officers to protect fraudulent call centers and other illegal operations.
